details.story: As a repository manager, I want to add an object to one or more collections, so that it appears in the appropriate collection browse hierarchies.
details.reason: S8 covers composing collections, but no story explicitly covers adding existing objects to collections.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to reorder components within an object, so that the presented component order matches the intellectual arrangement.
details.reason: Stories represent and list component order but do not cover changing the order.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to record relationships between objects, so that users can discover related resources.
details.reason: Relationships are covered for collections and components, but not for object-to-object links.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to manage user accounts and assign roles, so that only authorized users can perform repository manager or DAMS manager functions.
details.reason: Access constraints exist for curatorial access, but no story covers account and role management.

details.story: As a user, I want to view or download an access derivative of a content file, so that I do not have to download a large master file.
details.reason: S45 allows access to content files to judge size, but no derivative access copy is mentioned.

details.story: As a user, I want to request access or reproduction permission for a restricted object or component, so that I can use materials that are not openly available.
details.reason: Rights and restrictions are recorded, but no user workflow for requesting use is included.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to receive an alert when a content file checksum changes or an integrity issue is detected, so that I can investigate promptly.
details.reason: S62 and S63 let managers know about changed checksums, but no notification mechanism is specified.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to know the file format and format risk for each master file, so that I can plan preservation migrations.
details.reason: Existing stories cover checksums and source capture but not format risk assessment.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to generate reports of holdings by repository, collection, and object count, so that I can support planning and reporting.
details.reason: The backlog includes listing and browsing but no aggregate reporting.

details.story: As a user, I want to export a citation or metadata record for a collection, object, or component, so that I can reference it in my work.
details.reason: Users can know about identifiers and facets, but no export or citation function is included.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to apply rights information to multiple objects or components at once, so that I can maintain rights metadata efficiently.
details.reason: Rights stories are all at the individual object or component level; no bulk operation exists.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to specify the role of a content file, so that users and managers can distinguish file types such as master, access derivative, or thumbnail.
details.reason: S40 associates files with objects or components but does not include file role or use type.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to set access and use conditions on an object or component, so that users can know how they may access and use it.
details.reason: S53 and S75 cover knowing these conditions, but not setting or maintaining them by repository managers.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect unreliable or gaming volunteer behavior, so that their classifications can be excluded or down-weighted.
